attrs.evidence: docs/spec/proof-wire/SPEC-RELEASE.json binding every normative file, the public corpus, the pinned upstream JCS import and the holdout commitment -- the counts are DERIVED and PRINTED by spec_release.mjs and deliberately not restated here, because this sentence carried a hand-typed 5 and 11 against a tree holding 4 and 10; spec_release.mjs verifies and names WHICH file moved, and issues a release only under an explicit --update with a revision. governance/holdout/ holds ten constructions (H1-H10) carrying SPEC-DERIVED expectations and ZERO recorded hashes, because recording this implementation's answers and hiding them would make it the oracle by virtue of being first. attrs.statement: EVERY FROZEN CONFORMANCE CORPUS IDENTIFIES THE EXACT IMMUTABLE NORMATIVE RELEASE IT TESTS -- normative documents, machine-readable schema, external conformance dependencies and corpus revision -- BY CRYPTOGRAPHIC DIGEST. Three normative surfaces existed with nothing binding them: the Markdown, the schema, the corpus. Measured: changing the citation-identity formula in the normative Markdown from `TRVM-VERIFIED-CLAIM-v1|` to `TRVM-VERIFIED-CLAIM-EVIL|`, touching no code, no schema and no vector, left BOTH gates green -- one compares the checker with the schema and the other compares the checker with the corpus, and neither reads the prose. A tree digest taken during a run proves only that the run did not WRITE; it does not prove the tree is the one the corpus was issued against. THE RELEASE OBJECT EXCLUDES ITSELF FROM ITS OWN PREIMAGE, defines its file set and lexical ordering explicitly, and digests path-plus-content so a RENAME moves it as surely as an edit. AND REVISION NUMBERS ARE LABELS WHILE DIGESTS ARE IDENTITIES: protocol version, spec revision and corpus revision move independently, two releases may both call themselves revision 1, and a conformance report therefore cites the digest. A HIDDEN CHALLENGE SET IS COMMITTED RATHER THAN PUBLISHED: its contents live outside the specification tree so that shipping the specification cannot leak them, and only the commitment travels.
